speaker: Unknown
en: So the internet calls me one of the most AI psychotic people online.
zh: 所以互联网称我是网上最 AI 精神病的人之一。

speaker: Unknown
en: So it's only right that I start my talk with a story about one of the most canceled men in history.
zh: 所以我以一个关于历史上最受抵制的男子的故事来开始我的演讲是再合适不过了。

speaker: Unknown
en: His name was Baruch Spinoza.
zh: 他的名字是 Baruch Spinoza。

speaker: Unknown
en: And in case the philosophy elective wasn't your thing, here are the highlights you need to know.
zh: 以防哲学选修课不是你的菜，这里是你需要知道的亮点。

speaker: Unknown
en: In 1929, a New York rabbi challenged Einstein by telegram.
zh: 1929 年，一位纽约拉比通过电报挑战 Einstein。

speaker: Unknown
en: Do you believe in God?
zh: 你相信上帝吗？

speaker: Unknown
en: Answer in 50 words.
zh: 用 50 字回答。

speaker: Unknown
en: Einstein answered in 25.
zh: Einstein 用 25 个字回答了。

speaker: Unknown
en: I believe in Spinoza's God, who reveals himself in the lawful harmony of the world, not in a God who concerns himself with the fate and doings of mankind.
zh: 我相信 Spinoza 的上帝，他在世界的合法和谐中揭示自己，而不是在一个关心人类命运和行为的上帝。

speaker: Unknown
en: The most famous scientist alive asked the biggest question there is, pointed at Spinoza.
zh: 这位在世的最著名的科学家提出了最大的问题，指向了 Spinoza。

speaker: Unknown
en: But here's what Baruch Spinoza's own community did to him.
zh: 但这就是 Baruch Spinoza 自己的社区对他做的事。

speaker: Unknown
en: Amsterdam, July 27, 1656.
zh: 阿姆斯特丹，1656 年 7 月 27 日。

speaker: Unknown
en: Spinoza is 23 years old, a member of a tight-knit Sephardic Jewish community.
zh: Spinoza 23 岁，是一个紧密团结的塞法迪犹太社区的成员。

speaker: Unknown
en: He stands in a synagogue while the elders excommunicate him with the most violent curse the community ever produced.
zh: 他站在犹太会堂里，长辈们用该社区有史以来最恶毒的诅咒将他逐出教会。

speaker: Unknown
en: Cursed be he by day and cursed be he by night.
zh: 愿他白天受诅咒，愿他夜晚受诅咒。

speaker: Unknown
en: Cursed be he when he lies down and cursed be he when he rises up.
zh: 愿他躺下时受诅咒，愿他起来时受诅咒。

speaker: Unknown
en: Nobody may speak to him.
zh: 任何人不得对他说话。

speaker: Unknown
en: Nobody may trade with him.
zh: 任何人不得与他交易。

speaker: Unknown
en: Nobody may come within four cubits of him.
zh: 任何人不得进入他四肘尺的范围之内。

speaker: Unknown
en: Nobody may read anything he writes.
zh: 任何人不得读他写的任何东西。

speaker: Unknown
en: And this ban, uniquely among the roughly 40 bans Spinoza's community issued that century, has no repentance clause.
zh: 这项禁令，在该世纪 Spinoza 的社区发布的大约 40 项禁令中是独一无二的，没有悔改条款。

speaker: Unknown
en: It has never been lifted.
zh: 它从未被解除。

speaker: Unknown
en: It technically is still in force today.
zh: 技术上讲，它今天仍然有效。

speaker: Unknown
en: Spinoza was 23.
zh: Spinoza 那时 23 岁。

speaker: Unknown
en: His crime was evil opinions expressing forbidden thoughts.
zh: 他的罪行是邪恶的观点，表达禁忌的思想。

speaker: Unknown
en: His punishment was complete deletion from the community.
zh: 他的惩罚是从社区中彻底删除。

speaker: Unknown
en: Before his community cursed him, they tried to buy him a thousand guilders a year, serious money.
zh: 在他的社区诅咒他之前，他们试图每年给他一千荷兰盾，这是一笔巨款。

speaker: Unknown
en: All he had to do was show up at synagogue once in a while and keep his mouth shut.
zh: 他所要做的就是偶尔去犹太会堂，并闭上嘴。

speaker: Unknown
en: Hear that in founder terms.
zh: 用创始人的术语来听听这个。

speaker: Unknown
en: They've offered him a salary to stop building.
zh: 他们给他提供了一份薪水让他停止构建。

speaker: Unknown
en: He said, no, not for 10,000, he said.
zh: 他说，不，不为了 10,000，他说。

speaker: Unknown
en: He wanted truth, not comfort.
zh: 他想要真理，而不是舒适。

speaker: Unknown
en: Shortly before his excommunication, a fanatic came at him with a knife.
zh: 在他被逐出教会前不久，一个狂热分子拿着刀袭击了他。

speaker: Unknown
en: The blade tore through his cloak and missed him.
zh: 刀刃划破了他的斗篷，没有击中他。

speaker: Unknown
en: He kept that cloak, scar unmended, for the rest of his life.
zh: 他保留了那件斗篷，疤痕未修补，直到他的余生。

speaker: Unknown
en: He wanted to remember what ideas cost.
zh: 他想记住想法的代价。

speaker: Unknown
en: So what does the most canceled man of the 17th century do next?
zh: 那么，这位 17 世纪最受抵制的男子接下来做了什么？

speaker: Unknown
en: He grinds lenses.
zh: 他打磨镜片。

speaker: Unknown
en: By day, he makes optical instruments, tools that let human beings see further than their eyes allow.
zh: 白天，他制造光学仪器，这些工具让人类看得比他们的眼睛允许的更远。

speaker: Unknown
en: He makes them so well that the best scientists in Europe seek them out.
zh: 他把它们做得非常好，以至于欧洲最好的科学家都来寻找它们。

speaker: Unknown
en: And by night, he writes a book so dangerous he cannot publish it while he is alive.
zh: 晚上，他写了一本非常危险的书，他在世时无法出版。

speaker: Unknown
en: When he dies at 44, lungs full of glass dust from making other people's lenses, the manuscript is locked in his writing desk.
zh: 当他 44 岁去世时，因制作别人的镜片肺部充满玻璃粉尘，手稿被锁在他的写字台里。

speaker: Unknown
en: His dying instruction?
zh: 他的临终指示？

speaker: Unknown
en: Ship the desk by canal barge to his publisher in Amsterdam.
zh: 通过运河驳船将写字台运给他在阿姆斯特丹的出版商。

speaker: Unknown
en: That manuscript became his posthumous works, which attracted immediate attention across Europe and inspired some of the most important philosophers of the Enlightened.
zh: 那份手稿成为了他的遗作，立即引起了全欧洲的关注，并启发了启蒙运动中一些最重要的哲学家。

speaker: Unknown
en: What does Spinoza have to do with startups, you might ask?
zh: 你可能会问，Spinoza 和初创公司有什么关系？

speaker: Unknown
en: Well, here is a man canceled by everyone he knew, offered a salary to stop, nearly killed for shipping, and his response was to build precision tools by day and write the most dangerous book in Europe by night alone with no permission from anybody.
zh: 嗯，这里有一个人被他认识的每个人抵制，被提供薪水来停止，因为发布几乎被杀，而他的反应是白天制造精密工具，晚上独自在欧洲写最危险的书，没有任何人的许可。

speaker: Unknown
en: If you're gonna start a startup, you could do well to learn from Spinoza.
zh: 如果你要创办一家初创公司，你可以向 Spinoza 好好学习。

speaker: Unknown
en: He had a name for the engine that kept him going.
zh: 他给那个让他继续下去的引擎起了一个名字。

speaker: Unknown
en: it means your striving, the drive in every living thing to keep going and to increase its power to act.
zh: 它的意思是你的奋斗，每个生物中不断前进并增加其行动能力的动力。

speaker: Unknown
en: Not your resume, not your title, not your job, the striving itself.
zh: 不是你的简历，不是你的头衔，不是你的工作，而是奋斗本身。

speaker: Unknown
en: This talk is about the tools that amplify it.
zh: 这次演讲是关于放大它的工具。

speaker: Unknown
en: So what did he actually say that was worth deleting a man over?
zh: 那么他到底说了什么，值得为此除掉一个人？

speaker: Unknown
en: The gist of the heresy was that God is not a king on a throne.
zh: 这个异端的要点是，上帝不是宝座上的王。

speaker: Unknown
en: God is spread through everything that exists.
zh: 上帝散布在存在的一切事物中。

speaker: Unknown
en: God or nature, he wrote.
zh: 他写道，上帝或自然。

speaker: Unknown
en: 400 years later, we are making a similar mistake about intelligence.
zh: 400 年后，我们在关于智能方面正在犯一个类似的错误。

speaker: Unknown
en: Everyone is waiting for AGI as a singular event, a god in a data center, some announcement, some threshold, some day when the sky changes color.
zh: 每个人都在等待 AGI 作为一个单一事件，数据中心里的神，某个公告，某个阈值，某天天空变色的一天。

speaker: Unknown
en: So now I'll say a version of Spinoza's heresy, updated 400 years later.
zh: 所以现在我要说一个斯宾诺莎异端的版本，在 400 年后更新。

speaker: Unknown
en: Everyone is watching the sky.
zh: 每个人都在注视着天空。

speaker: Unknown
en: And the thing they're watching for is already in the room.
zh: 而他们注视的东西已经在房间里了。

speaker: Unknown
en: It doesn't look like a god.
zh: 它看起来不像神。

speaker: Unknown
en: It looks like infrastructure, a terminal window, a folder of markdown files, a job that finishes while you sleep.
zh: 它看起来像基础设施，一个终端窗口，一个 markdown 文件夹，一个在你睡觉时完成的工作。

speaker: Unknown
en: Spread through everything, which is exactly where Sminoza told you to look.
zh: 散布在一切事物中，这正是斯宾诺莎告诉你要去寻找的地方。

speaker: Unknown
en: AGI isn't arriving as an event.
zh: AGI 不会作为一个事件到来。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's arriving diffused as your agent.
zh: 它作为你的智能体扩散到来。

speaker: Unknown
en: Running on your context, doing your work.
zh: 在你的上下文上运行，做你的工作。

speaker: Unknown
en: I call it personal AGI, not artificial general intelligence for everyone all at once, general intelligence for one person, you.
zh: 我称之为个人 AGI，不是一次给所有人的人工通用智能，而是给一个人的通用智能，你。

speaker: Unknown
en: This was a dream of a great many people.
zh: 这是许多人的梦想。

speaker: Unknown
en: Vannevar Bush called it the Memex, a machine that would be an extension of yourself and your brain.
zh: 万尼瓦尔·布什称之为 Memex，一台将成为你自己和你大脑延伸的机器。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I want to be precise about what I mean because the words personal AI has already been captured by marketing departments.
zh: 我想对我所说的意思精确一些，因为个人 AI 这个词已经被营销部门捕获了。

speaker: Unknown
en: I do not mean a chatbot you pay $20 a month to.
zh: 我不是指你每个月付 20 美元的聊天机器人。

speaker: Unknown
en: I do not mean a slightly better autocomplete.
zh: 我不是指一个稍微好一点的自动补全。

speaker: Unknown
en: I do not mean an assistant that knows your calendar and nothing else.
zh: 我不是指一个只知道你的日历而其他一无所知的助手。

speaker: Unknown
en: That's just a subscription you rent.
zh: 那只是你租用的订阅。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's a corporate AGI you don't own.
zh: 那是一个你不拥有的公司 AGI。

speaker: Unknown
en: It resets when you close the tab.
zh: 当你关闭标签页时它就会重置。

speaker: Unknown
en: It knows what everyone else already knows.
zh: 它只知道其他人已经知道的事情。

speaker: Unknown
en: And when the company behind it pivots, your so-called assistant gets a lobotomy on someone else's schedule.
zh: 而当其背后的公司转型时，你所谓的助手就会按照别人的时间表接受脑叶切除。

speaker: Unknown
en: Personal AGI is a different animal.
zh: 个人 AGI 是一种不同的动物。

speaker: Unknown
en: An agent that runs on your infrastructure, reads from a memory you own, executes procedures you wrote, and compounds.
zh: 一个在你的基础设施上运行、从你拥有的内存中读取、执行你编写的程序并不断复利的智能体。

speaker: Unknown
en: The corporate AGI you don't own gets better only when the company ships something.
zh: 你不拥有的公司 AGI 只有在公司发布某些东西时才会变得更好。

speaker: Unknown
en: Your personal AGI gets better every single day you use it because every day it knows more of your life.
zh: 你的个人 AGI 在你使用的每一天都会变得更好，因为每一天它都知道你生活中的更多事情。

speaker: Unknown
en: One of these is a product you consume.
zh: 其中一个是你要消费的产品。

speaker: Unknown
en: The other is an asset you build.
zh: 另一个是你构建的资产。

speaker: Unknown
en: Almost nobody in the world has this second thing yet.
zh: 世界上几乎还没有人拥有这第二样东西。

speaker: Unknown
en: And everyone in this arena could have it by Monday.
zh: 而在这个领域的每个人到周一就能拥有它。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I believe intelligence, intelligence of this kind, should be owned.
zh: 我相信智能，这种智能，应该被拥有。

speaker: Unknown
en: Owned by you, not rented.
zh: 被你拥有，而不是租用。

speaker: Unknown
en: If you go forth and build this for yourself, 2034 doesn't have to be like 1984.
zh: 如果你继续前进为自己构建这个，2034 年就不必像 1984 年那样。

speaker: Unknown
en: You might ask why this personal AGI is happening only now.
zh: 你可能会问为什么这个个人 AGI 现在才发生。

speaker: Unknown
en: Well, I think it's because of what agents can do and nowhere is it more obvious than encoding agents.
zh: 嗯，我认为这是因为智能体能做什么，而在编码智能体方面最为明显。

speaker: Unknown
en: In 2013, I was a YC partner building Bookface, our internal social network, at night.
zh: 2013 年，我是 YC 合伙人，晚上在构建 Bookface，我们的内部社交网络。

speaker: Unknown
en: I shipped maybe 14 useful lines of code a day, which if you know the literature on programmer productivity is...
zh: 我每天大概发布 14 行有用的代码，如果你了解程序员生产力的文献的话，那是……

speaker: Unknown
en: Dead on median.
zh: 正好是中位数。

speaker: Unknown
en: That was me at full effort.
zh: 那是我在全力以赴时的状态。

speaker: Unknown
en: This year I run YC full time.
zh: 这一年我全职运营 YC。

speaker: Unknown
en: Same brain, same hours, plus a 5 o'clock kid pickup.
zh: 同样的大脑，同样的小时数，加上下午 5 点接孩子。

speaker: Unknown
en: I did the math on my output and I'm at about 400x what I did in 2013.
zh: 我计算了我的产出，我大约是 2013 年的 400 倍。

speaker: Unknown
en: Now, before the skeptic in row three deflates that number for me, let me deflate that for myself.
zh: 现在，在第三排的怀疑者为我降低那个数字之前，让我自己来降低它。

speaker: Unknown
en: You don't trust the raw lines of code?
zh: 你不信任那些原始的代码行吗？

speaker: Unknown
en: Fine.
zh: 好吧。

speaker: Unknown
en: Apply the most pathological verbosity penalty you can stomach and assume the agent writes bloated code.
zh: 施加你能忍受的最极端的冗长惩罚，并假设智能体会写出臃肿的代码。

speaker: Unknown
en: Assume half of it is scaffolding.
zh: 假设其中一半是脚手架。

speaker: Unknown
en: Assume I'm flattering myself, which is always a live possibility.
zh: 假设我在自欺欺人，这总是一种存在的可能性。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's still 8x at the absolute floor and 10 times that in the middle of the range.
zh: 这仍然是绝对底线上的 8 倍，以及中间范围的 10 倍。

speaker: Unknown
en: The number is large no matter how you torture it.
zh: 无论你怎么折腾，这个数字都很大。

speaker: Unknown
en: Now, this is just code, and if you're at the beginning of your career, you're in luck.
zh: 现在，这仅仅关乎代码，如果你处于职业生涯的早期，你很幸运。

speaker: Unknown
en: This applies to design.
zh: 这适用于设计。

speaker: Unknown
en: This applies to product management.
zh: 这适用于产品管理。

speaker: Unknown
en: This applies to growth.
zh: 这适用于增长。

speaker: Unknown
en: This applies to every part of what you might want to do.
zh: 这适用于你可能想做的每一部分工作。

speaker: Unknown
en: The multiplier for coding is not just for coding.
zh: 编码的乘数不仅仅是为了编码。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's for every piece of knowledge work.
zh: 它适用于每一项知识工作。

speaker: Unknown
en: And it's not just me.
zh: 而且不仅仅是我。

speaker: Unknown
en: At YC, we get to watch this at portfolio scale.
zh: 在 YC，我们有机会在投资组合规模上观察这一点。

speaker: Unknown
en: A year and a half ago in the Winter 25 batch, a quarter of the companies had codebases that were 95% AI generated.
zh: 一年半前，在 Winter 25 批次中，四分之一的公司拥有 95% AI 生成的代码库。

speaker: Unknown
en: Those companies use AI agents for everything now, not just code.
zh: 那些公司现在将 AI 智能体用于一切，不仅仅是代码。

speaker: Unknown
en: And that batch is on track to becoming one of the fastest growing, most profitable batches in the history of YC.
zh: 该批次正成为 YC 历史上增长最快、最盈利的批次之一。

speaker: Unknown
en: Now, I know what a correlation is, so let me say it carefully.
zh: 现在，我知道什么是相关性，所以让我谨慎地说一下。

speaker: Unknown
en: I cannot prove that the AI generated code and everything else caused the growth, but what I can tell you is that the fastest growing founders we fund are not treating AI as autocomplete.
zh: 我无法证明 AI 生成的代码和其他一切导致了这种增长，但我可以告诉你的是，我们资助的增长最快的企业家并没有将 AI 视为自动补全。

speaker: Unknown
en: They are treating it as a workforce.
zh: 他们将其视为劳动力。

speaker: Unknown
en: There are 2x people and there are 100x people who are using the same Claude, same weights, same context window size, same API.
zh: 有 2 倍的人，也有 100 倍的人，他们使用相同的 Claude、相同的权重、相同的上下文窗口大小、相同的 API。

speaker: Unknown
en: But the leverage is not in the weights.
zh: 但杠杆不在于权重。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's in what context you give it, how relevant it is, and does it happen at the right step.
zh: 而在于你给它什么样的上下文，它有多相关，以及它是否发生在正确的步骤。

speaker: Unknown
en: We'll come back to this.
zh: 我们稍后再谈这个。

speaker: Unknown
en: Now, Spinoza has a definition I think about every single week.
zh: 现在，斯宾诺莎有一个定义，我每周都会想到。

speaker: Unknown
en: In ethics, he defines joy as the feeling of your power of acting increasing, which is why the first time an agent does a week of your work in an afternoon, it doesn't feel like a convenience.
zh: 在伦理学中，他将快乐定义为你行为能力增加的感觉，这就是为什么第一次智能体在一个下午完成了你一周的工作时，它不感觉像是一种便利。

speaker: Unknown
en: It feels like joy.
zh: 它感觉像快乐。

speaker: Unknown
en: And that's not me being poetic.
zh: 这不是我在诗意化。

speaker: Unknown
en: That's the technical term.
zh: 这是技术术语。

speaker: Unknown
en: Your power of acting increased.
zh: 你的行为能力增强了。

speaker: Unknown
en: Your canatus just got bigger.
zh: 你的愿力变大了。

speaker: Unknown
en: He defined the opposite too, by the way, sadness, the feeling of your power of acting decreasing.
zh: 顺便说一下，他也定义了相反的概念，悲伤，即你的行为能力减弱的感觉。

speaker: Unknown
en: If your Sunday nights have a specific heaviness, like your ability to influence the world is receding, that you feel like you're quiet quitting, then this is what you feel and hold that thought because we're coming back to this in the second half of this talk and it gets political.
zh: 如果你的周日晚上有一种特有的沉重感，就像你影响世界的能力正在消退，你感觉像你在安静地辞职，那么这就是你的感觉，保留这个想法，因为我们将在演讲的后半部分回到这一点，它变得政治化了。

speaker: Unknown
en: So here's the equation for the next decade of your life.
zh: 所以这就是你未来十年的方程式。

speaker: Unknown
en: A frontier model, which is rented, and a commodity, and getting cheaper by the quarter, plus your context, which is owned by you and unique, and ideally nobody else on this earth has it, plus a harness that wires them together.
zh: 一个前沿模型，它是租用的，是一种商品，并且按季度变得越来越便宜，加上你的上下文，它由你拥有且独一无二，理想情况下这个地球上的其他人都没有，加上一个将它们连接在一起的线束。

speaker: Unknown
en: That harness might be OpenClaw, Hermes Agent, Claude Code, or Codex.
zh: 那个线束可能是 OpenClaw、Hermes Agent、Claude Code 或 Codex。

speaker: Unknown
en: Add that up, and that gives you an agent that acts like a very fast version of you.
zh: 把这些加起来，你就得到了一个智能体，它表现得像一个非常快速的版本的你自己。

speaker: Unknown
en: Model quality is rented, but your brain is owned ideally by you.
zh: 模型质量是租来的，但你的大脑理想情况下是由你自己拥有的。

speaker: Unknown
en: Marshall McLuhan said that technology is an extension of man.
zh: 马歇尔·麦克卢汉说，技术是人的延伸。

speaker: Unknown
en: Steve Jobs called a computer a bicycle for the mind.
zh: 史蒂夫·乔布斯称计算机为思想的自行车。

speaker: Unknown
en: And if you have what I'm describing here, then you have a self-driving rocket.
zh: 如果你拥有我在这里描述的东西，那么你就拥有了一辆自动驾驶的火箭。

speaker: Unknown
en: Paul Graham taught every founder in this building two things.
zh: 保罗·格雷厄姆教会了这栋楼里的每一位创始人两件事。

speaker: Unknown
en: Make something people want and do things that don't scale.
zh: 制造人们想要的东西，做不可扩展的事情。

speaker: Unknown
en: Both still govern everything.
zh: 这两点仍然主导着一切。

speaker: Unknown
en: What's new is the multiplier on the second one.
zh: 新的是第二点的乘数。

speaker: Unknown
en: Agents are how one founder now does unscalable things at scale.
zh: 智能体就是一位创始人现在如何以规模做不可扩展的事情。

speaker: Unknown
en: The advice didn't change, but the physics of all startups and of what you can do did.
zh: 建议没有改变，但所有初创公司的物理法则以及你能做的事情改变了。

speaker: Unknown
en: Spinoza ground lenses, instruments that let people see past the limits of their eyes.
zh: 斯宾诺莎磨制镜片，那是让人们看到视力极限之外的仪器。

speaker: Unknown
en: I want to spend the next 15 minutes showing you what grinding lenses for the mind looks like.
zh: 我想用接下来的 15 分钟 向你们展示 为大脑打磨镜片 是什么样子。

speaker: Unknown
en: This is the machinery I actually run my life on, and every concept travels to whatever stack you use.
zh: 这就是 我实际用来 运行我生活的 机器，而且 每一个概念 都会传播到 你使用的 任何技术栈。

speaker: Unknown
en: Let's start with working memory because it explains everything.
zh: 让我们从 工作记忆 开始，因为它 解释了一切。

speaker: Unknown
en: You and I as human beings hold about seven things in our head at once, seven plus or minus two.
zh: 作为人类，你和我的 脑海中 一次只能保持 大约七件事，七 加或减 两。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's the most famous paper in cognitive psychology.
zh: 这是 认知心理学 最著名的 论文。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's why local phone numbers are seven digits and why you forget the eighth item on a grocery list.
zh: 这就是 为什么 本地电话号码 是七位数，以及 为什么你会忘记 杂货清单上的 第八件物品。

speaker: Unknown
en: That is the entire working memory of a human being.
zh: 这就是 人类 工作记忆 的全部。

speaker: Unknown
en: And every institution humanity has ever built, every checklist, every org chart, every filing cabinet, every stand-up meeting is a prosthetic for that limit.
zh: 人类建立的 每一个机构，每一份 检查清单，每一个 组织架构图，每一个 档案柜，每一次 站会，都是 对这一限制的 义肢。

speaker: Unknown
en: An AI agent, though, holds a million tokens.
zh: 然而，一个 AI 智能体，能容纳 一百万个 token。

speaker: Unknown
en: That's about a thousand pages.
zh: 那大约是 一千页。

speaker: Unknown
en: Three Harry Potter books sitting open on its head all at once.
zh: 三本 《哈利·波特》的书 同时在 它的 头顶 上摊开。

speaker: Unknown
en: And it can find a needle in any of them and synthesize across all three in seconds.
zh: 而且它可以 在几秒钟内 在它们中的任何一本里 找到一根针，并 跨越所有这三本 进行综合。

speaker: Unknown
en: Three Harry Potter books versus seven digits.
zh: 三本 《哈利·波特》的书 对比 七个数字。

speaker: Unknown
en: You could argue that's not quite AGI yet, but it is already a different operating regime.
zh: 你可能会认为 这还不是 完全的 AGI，但它 已经是一种 不同的 运行机制。

speaker: Unknown
en: And almost everyone on earth is still running their life on an org chart and a way of doing things designed for the seven digit brain.
zh: 地球上 几乎所有人 仍然在 组织架构图和 为 七个数字的大脑 设计的 行事方式 上 运行他们的生活。

speaker: Unknown
en: Run that number in the other direction.
zh: 把这个数字 在另一个 方向 运行一下。

speaker: Unknown
en: A thousand pages is a lot, but it is also very little.
zh: 一千页 很多，但也 非常少。

speaker: Unknown
en: Your life is not three books.
zh: 你的生活 不是 三本书。

speaker: Unknown
en: Your life is a library.
zh: 你的生活 是一座 图书馆。

speaker: Unknown
en: Every email you ever sent, every meeting, every decision, and every reason behind it, every conversation with every person you know.
zh: 你发送的 每一封邮件，每一次 会议，每一个决定，以及 背后的 每一个原因，和你认识的 每一个人的 每一次对话。

speaker: Unknown
en: The question that determines whether your agent
zh: 决定 你的 智能体

speaker: Unknown
en: Is a genius or a goldfish is this.
zh: 是天才 还是金鱼的 问题 是这个。

speaker: Unknown
en: Who decides or what decides which three books are open on the desk?
zh: 谁决定 或者什么决定 哪三本书 在桌子上 打开？

speaker: Unknown
en: And that's what a brain is.
zh: 这就是 大脑的 本质。

speaker: Unknown
en: That's what Gbrain is meant to be.
zh: 这就是 Gbrain 旨在成为的 样子。

speaker: Unknown
en: The library plus the librarian.
zh: 图书馆 加上 图书管理员。

speaker: Unknown
en: I've been building Gbrain in the open.
zh: 我一直在 公开 构建 Gbrain。

speaker: Unknown
en: My personal open claw has a Karpathy-style knowledge wiki with about 220,000 markdown pages.
zh: 我的 个人 open claw 拥有 Karpathy 风格的 知识 wiki，大约有 220,000 个 markdown 页面。

speaker: Unknown
en: 25 years of my life, diarized.
zh: 我 25 年的 生活，被 记录了下来。

speaker: Unknown
en: Every email, every meeting, my notes, my photos, my drafts, the things I got wrong.
zh: 每一封邮件，每一次 会议，我的 笔记，我的 照片，我的 草稿，我 搞砸的 事情。

speaker: Unknown
en: Compiled mostly by agents, curated by agents, searched for by agents, but I never re-ask a question I already answered.
zh: 大部分由 智能体 编译，由 智能体 策展，由 智能体 搜索，但我 从不 重新问一个 我已经 回答过的 问题。

speaker: Unknown
en: The lived experience in the system is the point.
zh: 系统中的 亲身体验 才是 关键。

speaker: Unknown
en: A founder emails me about a crisis.
zh: 一位 创始人 给我发邮件 关于 危机。

speaker: Unknown
en: Before I finish reading the email, my agent has already pulled every prior conversation I've had with that founder, three portfolio companies that hit the same wall, and what actually worked for them.
zh: 在我 读完邮件之前，我的 智能体 已经 提取了 我与那位 创始人 之前的 每一次对话，三家 撞了同一堵墙 的 投资组合公司，以及 对他们 真正有效的 东西。

speaker: Unknown
en: When my agent does anything, it does knowing everything I know.
zh: 当我的 智能体 做任何事情时，它 都是在知道 我所知道的 一切的情况下 去做的。

speaker: Unknown
en: And that's the difference between an assistant and a colleague.
zh: 这就是 助手 和 同事 之间的 区别。

speaker: Unknown
en: Let me walk you through an actual day because that matters more than an architecture diagram.
zh: 让我带你 走过 真实的一天，因为这比 架构图 更重要。

speaker: Unknown
en: While I slept last night, my agent processed my inbox.
zh: 昨晚 我睡觉时，我的 智能体 处理了我的 收件箱。

speaker: Unknown
en: Not sorted it, processed it.
zh: 不是 排序，而是 处理。

speaker: Unknown
en: It knows which emails are from founders in trouble, which are from people trying to sell me something, and which are from the 17 mailing lists I never quite unsubscribe from.
zh: 它知道 哪些邮件 是 遇到麻烦的 创始人 发来的，哪些是 试图 向我兜售东西的人 发来的，哪些是 我从未真正退订的 17 个 邮件列表 发来的。

speaker: Unknown
en: The ones that matter are triaged with context pulled from the library, who this person is, my whole history with them, what they're really asking under what they wrote, and what that might mean for me.
zh: 重要的邮件 会进行分诊，并从 图书馆中 提取 背景，这个人是谁，我与他们的 完整历史，他们 在所写文字之下 真正在问的是什么，以及 这对我 可能意味着什么。

speaker: Unknown
en: I wake up to a briefing, not a pile of emails.
zh: 我醒来 看到的是 简报，而不是 一堆 邮件。

speaker: Unknown
en: Before every meeting, a prep doc, who I'm meeting, what we said last time, what changed since, and what I should ask.
zh: 在每次 会议之前，一份 准备文档，我要见谁，我们 上次说了什么，此后 有什么变化，我应该 问什么。

speaker: Unknown
en: Research I was curious about at midnight is finished by morning.
zh: 我在 午夜 感兴趣的 研究 在早上 就完成了。

speaker: Unknown
en: And when something interesting happens in the world, my agent has usually read it, cross-referenced against what I care about, and filed it before I've had coffee.
zh: 当世界上 发生 有趣的事情时，我的 智能体 通常已经 读过它，与 我关心的内容 进行了交叉引用，并在 我喝咖啡之前 就已经 归档了。

speaker: Unknown
en: On top of this library sits my agentic coding framework, GStack, 123,000 stars now, which put it in the top 100 open source projects in the history of GitHub.
zh: 在这个 图书馆之上 坐落着 我的 智能 编码框架 GStack，现在有 123,000 个 star，这使它 成为 GitHub 历史上 前 100 名的 开源项目 之一。

speaker: Unknown
en: What's actually in the punchline of this full architecture?
zh: 这个 完整架构 的 亮点 到底是什么？

speaker: Unknown
en: It's mostly skill files, plus a browser that the agents can drive, pages of English, and a way to act on the world.
zh: 主要是 技能文件，加上 一个 智能体可以 驱动的 浏览器，英文页面，以及一种 作用于世界 的方式。

speaker: Unknown
en: Markdown, not magic.
zh: Markdown，而不是 魔法。

speaker: Unknown
en: Fat skills, thin harness.
zh: 胖技能，瘦线束。

speaker: Unknown
en: Let me show you what a skill file is because I keep saying this phrase and I want you to see how unmagical it is.
zh: 让我给你展示一下什么是技能文件，因为我一直说这个词，我想让你看看它有多么不神奇。

speaker: Unknown
en: Here's a real one, lightly redacted.
zh: 这就是一个真实的例子，经过了轻微的编辑。

speaker: Unknown
en: It says, when a meeting recording lands from Circleback, transcribe it with speaker labels, pull out the commitment made, who made it, and the deadline.
zh: 上面写着，当从 Circleback 收到会议录音时，使用说话人标签进行转录，提取做出的承诺、谁做出的以及截止日期。

speaker: Unknown
en: Cross-check every person named against the library and link their pages.
zh: 对照资料库交叉核对每一个提到的人，并链接他们的页面。

speaker: Unknown
en: File the summary here, full transcript there.
zh: 将摘要归档到这里，完整的逐字稿归档到那里。

speaker: Unknown
en: If anything contradicts something we already believe, flag it.
zh: 如果有任何内容与我们已知的信念相矛盾，将其标记出来。

speaker: Unknown
en: Don't overwrite it.
zh: 不要覆盖它。

speaker: Unknown
en: That's it.
zh: 就是这样。

speaker: Unknown
en: That's a skill.
zh: 这就是一项技能。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's a page of English.
zh: 它就是一页英文。

speaker: Unknown
en: A smart intern, anyone really who could read, could follow it.
zh: 一个聪明的实习生，任何真正识字的人，都可以照着做。

speaker: Unknown
en: And that's the test, actually.
zh: 这实际上就是测试标准。

speaker: Unknown
en: If a smart intern could follow it, an agent can run it.
zh: 如果一个聪明的实习生能照着做，智能体就能运行它。

speaker: Unknown
en: Which means actually a kind of profound thing.
zh: 这实际上意味着某种深刻的事情。

speaker: Unknown
en: I know I caught a lot of flack for talking about this, but I think it's more true than ever, especially now.
zh: 我知道我因为谈论这个而受到了很多批评，但我认为这比以往任何时候都更正确，尤其是现在。

speaker: Unknown
en: Markdown is actually code.
zh: Markdown 实际上就是代码。

speaker: Unknown
en: If you can write clear instructions in English, you're a programmer.
zh: 如果你能用英文写出清晰的指令，你就是程序员。

speaker: Unknown
en: The compiler is a language model.
zh: 编译器就是语言模型。

speaker: Unknown
en: And that's why it's not just for engineers anymore.
zh: 这就是为什么它不再仅仅是为工程师准备的。

speaker: Unknown
en: At YC, our media people, events staff, finance team, people who never opened a terminal in their lives are building skill files and scheduled jobs.
zh: 在 YC，我们的媒体人员、活动员工、财务团队，这些一生中从未打开过终端的人都在构建技能文件和定时任务。

speaker: Unknown
en: One of our finance folks compiled about 100 Excel workbooks into a single app she built with an internal agent.
zh: 我们的一位财务人员将大约 100 个 Excel 工作簿编译成了她用内部智能体构建的一个单一应用。

speaker: Unknown
en: She is not a programmer.
zh: 她不是程序员。

speaker: Unknown
en: She is a manager of agents now.
zh: 她现在是智能体的管理者。

speaker: Unknown
en: Everyone is about to be.
zh: 每个人都即将成为。

speaker: Unknown
en: The most important question to ask here is, where is the computation happening?
zh: 这里要问的最重要的问题是，计算发生在哪里？

speaker: Unknown
en: And there are exactly two answers, and confusing them causes every agent failure I've ever seen.
zh: 恰好有两个答案，混淆它们会导致我见过的每一次智能体失败。

speaker: Unknown
en: Some computation belongs in latent space.
zh: 有些计算属于潜在空间。

speaker: Unknown
en: Taste, judgment, reading what a human actually wants from a vague request.
zh: 品味、判断，从模糊的请求中解读人类真正想要的东西。

speaker: Unknown
en: That lives in the model and you steer it with a Markdown file.
zh: 这存在于模型中，你通过 Markdown 文件来引导它。

speaker: Unknown
en: And then some computation belongs in deterministic space.
zh: 然后有些计算属于确定性空间。

speaker: Unknown
en: The arithmetic, the SQL query, for instance, the seating chart for what sessions you're going to go to today for your breakouts.
zh: 算术运算，例如 SQL 查询，比如你今天要参加哪些会议的座位表。

speaker: Unknown
en: All of that needs to be stored in a SQL database used by the Markdown files.
zh: 所有这些都需要存储在一个 Markdown 文件使用的 SQL 数据库中。

speaker: Unknown
en: Being smart about this goes a long way.
zh: 对此保持清醒大有裨益。

speaker: Unknown
en: Ask an agent or human to seat five people around a table.
zh: 让智能体或人类安排五个人围坐在桌子旁。

speaker: Unknown
en: That's easy.
zh: 这很容易。

speaker: Unknown
en: Do it in latent space.
zh: 在潜在空间中做。

speaker: Unknown
en: Ask it to make custom schedules for 6,000 people in an arena like we just did for you, and your latent space agent needs to write some code to keep track of it.
zh: 让它为体育馆里的 6,000 人制定定制时间表，就像我们刚刚为你做的那样，你的潜在空间智能体需要编写一些代码来追踪它。

speaker: Unknown
en: Your experience at this conference.
zh: 你这次会议的体验。

speaker: Unknown
en: All of this had to be markdown files calling code in exactly this way.
zh: 所有这些都必须是以这种方式调用代码的 Markdown 文件。

speaker: Unknown
en: And you couldn't do it without the code.
zh: 没有代码你无法做到。

speaker: Unknown
en: The model fails where we fail.
zh: 模型在我们失败的地方失败。

speaker: Unknown
en: The fix is having the model compute the way humans compute.
zh: 解决办法是让模型以人类计算的方式进行计算。

speaker: Unknown
en: The latent and the deterministic, markdown files calling databases and scripts.
zh: 潜在空间和确定性空间，调用数据库和脚本的 Markdown 文件。

speaker: Unknown
en: Simple, but it's what everything is actually built on.
zh: 简单，但这就是所有事物实际构建的基础。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I'll give you one more receipt, my favorite one, because you're sitting inside it right now.
zh: 我再给你一个证据，我最喜欢的一个，因为你现在就身处其中。

speaker: Unknown
en: Five days ago, I decided this talk needed Spinoza, one of my favorite philosophers, especially because of how canceled he got.
zh: 五天前，我决定这次演讲需要 Spinoza，我最喜欢的哲学家之一，特别是因为他遭到了多少封杀。

speaker: Unknown
en: So my agent went and acquired three of the best biographies about the man, books by Nadler, Goldstein, and Stewart, about 1,500 pages.
zh: 所以我的智能体去获取了关于这个人的三本最好的传记，Nadler、Goldstein 和 Stewart 写的书，大约 1,500 页。

speaker: Unknown
en: It read all three.
zh: 它读完了全部三本。

speaker: Unknown
en: It built me a synthesis, a dated chronology of his life,
zh: 它为我构建了一份综合材料，他生活中的编年史，

speaker: Unknown
en: Every place the three biographers disagree with each other and the best verbatim quotes with chapter citations.
zh: 以及三位传记作者彼此不一致的每个地方，以及附有章节引用的最佳原话引用。

speaker: Unknown
en: And because it knows what I need, the 10 most tellable moments of his life ranked with delivery notes.
zh: 因为它知道我需要什么，它列出了他一生中最值得讲述的 10 个时刻，并附带了交付说明。

speaker: Unknown
en: The knife attack, the bribe, the desk.
zh: 持刀袭击、贿赂、办公桌。

speaker: Unknown
en: Every beat of our opening that might've given you some chills 20 minutes ago came out of that overnight run.
zh: 我们开场中每一个可能让你在 20 分钟前感到不寒而栗的节拍，都来自那次通宵运行。

speaker: Unknown
en: 1,500 pages became a stage-ready story that I could edit.
zh: 1500 页变成了一个我可以编辑的、准备登台的故事。

speaker: Unknown
en: I call it a compendium skill, and I use it daily.
zh: 我称它为一种「汇编技能」，我每天都在使用它。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's a personal skill that is a mega, mega version of deep research, only deeper than anything the corporate AI products will give you.
zh: 这是一种个人技能，它是深度研究的超级、超级版本，只是比任何企业级 AI 产品给你的都要更深。

speaker: Unknown
en: The spine of this talk you're watching was inspired by the machine we're describing now.
zh: 你正在观看的这个演讲的骨架，其灵感来源于我们现在正在描述的机器。

speaker: Unknown
en: And if you're wondering where mine actually started, it was not 220,000 pages.
zh: 如果你想知道我的实际上是从哪里开始的，它不是 220,000 页。

speaker: Unknown
en: It was a folder.
zh: 它是一个文件夹。

speaker: Unknown
en: It was a few markdown files about the companies I was working with and the people I kept emailing.
zh: 它是一些关于我正在合作的公司以及我一直联系的人的 Markdown 文件。

speaker: Unknown
en: And the library got big the same way anything gets big, a little every day compounding with agents doing the filing.
zh: 图书馆变大的方式与任何事物变大的方式一样，每天一点一点地累积，由智能体进行归档。

speaker: Unknown
en: Nobody builds the warehouse first.
zh: 没有人会先建造仓库。

speaker: Unknown
en: First you build one shelf.
zh: 你先造一个架子。

speaker: Unknown
en: When you sit down with an agent tonight, you're not coding.
zh: 当你今晚坐下来与一个智能体在一起时，你不是在编码。

speaker: Unknown
en: You're managing a workforce made of Markdown.
zh: 你在管理一支由 Markdown 组成的员工队伍。

speaker: Unknown
en: A skill file is an employee.
zh: 一个技能文件就是一名员工。

speaker: Unknown
en: It has one capability, one job written down clearly enough that someone new could execute it.
zh: 它只有一种能力，一份写得足够清楚的工作，以至于新人都能执行它。

speaker: Unknown
en: A resolver is an org chart.
zh: 一个解析器就是一个组织结构图。

speaker: Unknown
en: A task comes in and it decides which Markdown file or who handles it.
zh: 一个任务进来，它决定由哪个 Markdown 文件或谁来处理它。

speaker: Unknown
en: Which means that before you ever incorporate anything, before you have a co-founder or a logo or a deck, you can already be running an organization.
zh: 这意味着在你真正整合任何东西之前，在你拥有联合创始人、Logo 或演示文稿之前，你就可以已经在运营一家组织了。

speaker: Unknown
en: An organization of one, plus your agents.
zh: 一个人的组织，加上你的智能体们。

speaker: Unknown
en: You are the founder and the entire management layer of you incorporated and the headcount under you is now whatever you decide it is.
zh: 你是创始人，也是你这家公司的整个管理层，而你手下的人数现在就是无论你决定它是多少。

speaker: Unknown
en: This already produces companies that break the old math.
zh: 这已经产生了打破旧算术的公司。

speaker: Unknown
en: Emergent, out of our summer 24 batch, went from public launch to nine figures of revenue in eight months.
zh: Emergent，作为我们 24 年夏季批次的项目，从公开发布到八位数的收入只用了八个月。

speaker: Unknown
en: When they crossed $15 million in annualized revenue, they were 15 people.
zh: 当他们的年化收入超过 1500 万美元时，他们只有 15 人。

speaker: Unknown
en: Retail, winter 24, hit 60 million annualized with about 40.
zh: Retail，24 年冬季批次，在大约 40 人的规模下达到了 6000 万年化收入。

speaker: Unknown
en: That revenue per person did not exist before, not in software, not in oil, not in railroads.
zh: 这种人均收入以前是不存在的，无论是在软件业、石油业还是铁路业。

speaker: Unknown
en: And these aren't freaks of nature.
zh: 而且这些并不是自然界的怪胎。

speaker: Unknown
en: They're the first companies built natively on the new physics, and every one of them started as one or two people
zh: 它们是第一批基于新物理学原生构建的公司，而且它们每一个都是从一两个人开始的

speaker: Unknown
en: Wired the way I just described.
zh: 按照我刚才描述的方式连接。

speaker: Unknown
en: Now, picture our batch room in the dog patch.
zh: 现在，想象一下我们在 Dogpatch 的批次教室。

speaker: Unknown
en: Hundreds of founders, every single day, each one of them doing what used to be a person's entire year of work.
zh: 数百名创始人，每一天，他们每个人都在做着过去一个人整整一年的工作量。

speaker: Unknown
en: That is not the future.
zh: 那不是未来。

speaker: Unknown
en: That is the bar right now with this batch.
zh: 那是当前这个批次的标准线。

speaker: Unknown
en: If you're not doing it, your competitor is, and they will eat your lunch politely and thank you for it.
zh: 如果你不这样做，你的竞争对手会做的，他们会客气地吃掉你的午餐，并且还要为此感谢你。

speaker: Unknown
en: It also changes what software even is.
zh: 它也改变了软件的本质。

speaker: Unknown
en: Software doesn't have to be precious anymore.
zh: 软件不再需要那么「珍贵」了。

speaker: Unknown
en: You can build exactly the tool you need for the audience of one in a weekend.
zh: 你可以在一个周末内为唯一的受众构建出你真正需要的工具。

speaker: Unknown
en: The old advice was scratch your own itch and hope it's the market.
zh: 旧的建议是，解决你自己的痒点，并希望它就是市场。

speaker: Unknown
en: The new version is much better.
zh: 新版本要好得多。

speaker: Unknown
en: Scratch your own itch because scratching itches is nearly free and some of your tools for one will turn out to be entire companies.
zh: 解决你自己的痒点，因为解决痒点几乎是免费的，而且你为你自己制作的一些工具最终会变成完整的公司。

speaker: Unknown
en: You'll know because other people start begging for them.
zh: 你会知道的，因为其他人开始乞求得到这些工具。

speaker: Unknown
en: And one honest caveat before the how-to, because you catch me out in any way.
zh: 在进入「如何做」之前，有一个诚实的警告，因为你可能会在任何方面抓到我的把柄。

speaker: Unknown
en: A brain nobody curates is a garbage dump with great search.
zh: 一个没有人整理的大脑就是一个拥有伟大搜索功能的垃圾场。

speaker: Unknown
en: Retrieval will surface a stale fact with total confidence.
zh: 检索会以绝对的自信抛出一个陈旧的事实。

speaker: Unknown
en: A bad skill file encodes a bad process forever.
zh: 一个糟糕的技能文件会将一个糟糕的流程永远编码下来。

speaker: Unknown
en: So the primitive is memory plus hygiene, provenance on every fact, contradiction checks when new information collides with old, and a librarian whose actual job is pruning.
zh: 所以原语是记忆加上卫生，每个事实的来源证明，当新信息与旧信息冲突时的矛盾检查，以及一个实际工作是修剪的图书管理员。

speaker: Unknown
en: Treat the brain like production infrastructure and it compounds.
zh: 把大脑当作生产基础设施来对待，它就会复利增长。

speaker: Unknown
en: Treat it like a dumping ground and you get a very confident agent that is wrong in ways nobody can trace.
zh: 把它当作倾倒场，你会得到一个非常自信的智能体，它以没人能追踪的方式出错。

speaker: Unknown
en: Everything so far is philosophy and receipts.
zh: 到目前为止的一切都是哲学和收据。

speaker: Unknown
en: So let's get into some how-to.
zh: 那么让我们进入一些实操指南。

speaker: Unknown
en: If you do what I describe in the next six minutes, you'll be ahead of 99% of people who watched this talk and just nodded.
zh: 如果你在接下来的六分钟里做我描述的事情，你将领先于 99% 看了这个演讲只是点头的人。

speaker: Unknown
en: Step one tonight, pick a harness and run an agent on your own machine.
zh: 第一步，今晚，选一个套件并在你自己的机器上运行一个智能体。

speaker: Unknown
en: I use OpenClaw and Hermes Agent with Gbrain.
zh: 我使用 OpenClaw 和 Hermes Agent 以及 Gbrain。

speaker: Unknown
en: A hosted version of this is at gbrain.io.
zh: 一个托管版本在 gbrain.io。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's free.
zh: 它是免费的。

speaker: Unknown
en: Gbrain itself is free and open source.
zh: Gbrain 本身是免费和开源的。

speaker: Unknown
en: I always recommend the Ferrari, but I'll be honest, the Honda is really good too.
zh: 我总是推荐法拉利，但老实说，本田也真的很不错。

speaker: Unknown
en: Codex, Claude Code, whatever.
zh: Codex，Claude Code，不管什么。

speaker: Unknown
en: Any of them will do 99% of this, and the upside of not Ferrari is that it will also get you to your destination with a little less of less getting out to fix it on the side of the road.
zh: 任何一个都能完成 99% 的事情，而且不是法拉利的好处是它也能把你送到目的地，路边抛锚修理的情况会少一些。

speaker: Unknown
en: The concepts are the point, not any given repo or product.
zh: 重点在于概念，而不是任何特定的代码库或产品。

speaker: Unknown
en: The intelligence is on tap, and there are many paths.
zh: 智能是随取随用的，而且有很多路径。

speaker: Unknown
en: Step two this weekend, start your library, not a grand archive.
zh: 第二步，这个周末，开始建立你的库，不是一个大型的档案馆。

speaker: Unknown
en: One folder of markdown files, export your notes, export your email if you can.
zh: 一个 Markdown 文件夹，导出你的笔记，如果可以的话导出你的邮件。

speaker: Unknown
en: Write one page about each project you're working on and each person you work with.
zh: 为每个你正在做的项目和每个你一起工作的人写一页。

speaker: Unknown
en: And on those pages...
zh: 然后在这些页面上……

speaker: Unknown
en: Write the things you actually know, what you're building together, what they care about, what you owe them, what they said last time.
zh: 写下你真正知道的事情，你们在共同构建什么，他们关心什么，你欠他们什么，他们上次说了什么。

speaker: Unknown
en: That's stuff no model on Earth has, because it only exists in your head.
zh: 这些是地球上没有任何模型拥有的东西，因为它只存在于你的脑子里。

speaker: Unknown
en: And your head, as we established, only holds seven things.
zh: 而你的脑子，正如我们确定的，只能容纳七件事。

speaker: Unknown
en: The first time an agent answers a question using your context instead of the internet's, you'll feel the click and you won't go back.
zh: 第一次当一个智能体使用你的上下文而不是互联网来回答问题时，你会感到那种顿悟，你就不会再回头了。

speaker: Unknown
en: You are all sitting on five, 10 years of your own history in one inbox or another.
zh: 你们所有人的五到十年的历史都躺在一个或另一个收件箱里。

speaker: Unknown
en: That's your moat just lying there, unindexed, doing nothing.
zh: 那是你的护城河，就在那里，未被索引，无所作为。

speaker: Unknown
en: The only gate between you and this entire architecture is probably 24 hours.
zh: 你和整个架构之间唯一的大门可能就是 24 小时。

speaker: Unknown
en: Step three, write your first skill file.
zh: 第三步，编写你的第一个技能文件。

speaker: Unknown
en: Picking it is easy.
zh: 选择它很容易。

speaker: Unknown
en: You know, what's the task you do every single week that you hate the most?
zh: 你知道，你每周都要做的你最讨厌的任务是什么？

speaker: Unknown
en: Might be expense reports, meeting notes, the weekly status update, competitor research.
zh: 可能是费用报告、会议记录、每周状态更新、竞品研究。

speaker: Unknown
en: Explain it to your agent.
zh: 把它解释给你的智能体。

speaker: Unknown
en: What do you want to do?
zh: 你想做什么？

speaker: Unknown
en: In plain English, the way you'd explain to a smart friend on their first day of a job.
zh: 用平实的英语，就像你在工作第一天对一个聪明朋友解释那样。

speaker: Unknown
en: And then let it get it wrong.
zh: 然后让它出错。

speaker: Unknown
en: If it gets it wrong, correct it.
zh: 如果它出错了，纠正它。

speaker: Unknown
en: Every rule, every exception, every, oh, and also, put it in there and it'll fix it.
zh: 每一条规则，每一个例外，每一个，“哦，还有”，把它放进去，它就会修复它。

speaker: Unknown
en: That page is now an employee, run it.
zh: 那一页现在就是一个员工，运行它。

speaker: Unknown
en: Step four, wire it up to be a recurring job.
zh: 第四步，把它连接成一个循环任务。

speaker: Unknown
en: Maybe it's the job you just created in step three.
zh: 也许就是你在第三步刚创建的任务。

speaker: Unknown
en: Every morning at seven, do this.
zh: 每天早上七点，做这个。

speaker: Unknown
en: Every Friday, summarize that.
zh: 每周五，总结那个。

speaker: Unknown
en: The first time you wake up to work that finished while you slept, something shifts in your head permanently.
zh: 第一次你醒来时工作在你睡觉时已经完成，你脑子里会发生永久性的转变。

speaker: Unknown
en: The day stops being the unit of work for you.
zh: 这一天不再是你的工作单位。

speaker: Unknown
en: It becomes what you can imagine, and it should be driven by what your goals are and what you want to create in the world.
zh: 它变成了你能想象的东西，它应该由你的目标和你想在世界中创造什么来驱动。

speaker: Unknown
en: Step five, this is the discipline that separates the compounders from the dabblers.
zh: 第五步，这是区分复利者和浅尝辄止者的纪律。

speaker: Unknown
en: Never do one-off work.
zh: 永远不要做一次性工作。

speaker: Unknown
en: Most people run one operation with one agent and then throw the context away.
zh: 大多数人用一个智能体运行一个操作，然后把上下文扔掉。

speaker: Unknown
en: They close the window, that's it.
zh: 他们关闭窗口，就是这样。

speaker: Unknown
en: Don't.
zh: 别这样。

speaker: Unknown
en: At the end of every task, ask the agent to Skillify what it did.
zh: 在每个任务结束时，让智能体将它的行为技能化。

speaker: Unknown
en: Skillify is a special skill you can find in Gbrain.
zh: 技能化是你在 Gbrain 中可以找到的一个特殊技能。

speaker: Unknown
en: You can point it at that repo and say, extract Skillify, learn how to do it.
zh: 你可以指向那个代码库并说，提取技能化，学习如何做。

speaker: Unknown
en: Turn it into a markdown file you can use and reuse forever.
zh: 把它变成一个你可以永远重复使用的 Markdown 文件。

speaker: Unknown
en: I'll say it the way I say it at YC.
zh: 我就按照我在 YC 那样说。

speaker: Unknown
en: If you have to ask for something twice, you failed.
zh: 如果你必须把一件事请求两次，你就失败了。

speaker: Unknown
en: The person who captures what they learn gets smarter every single day.
zh: 那个捕捉自己学到的东西的人每一天都在变聪明。

speaker: Unknown
en: The person who wakes up every morning with amnesia, well, that's a waste of your time, and it sort of doesn't matter how good the model gets if you can't turn it into real memory.
zh: 那个每天早上醒来就失忆的人，嗯，那是浪费时间，而且如果你不能把它转化为真正的记忆，模型变得多好也并不重要。

speaker: Unknown
en: Do those five things, and I can tell you what your next 90 days look like.
zh: 做这五件事，我可以告诉你你接下来的 90 天会是什么样。

speaker: Unknown
en: Week one, honestly, it's a toy.
zh: 第一周，老实说，它是个玩具。

speaker: Unknown
en: The library's thin.
zh: 库很薄。

speaker: Unknown
en: The skills are clumsy.
zh: 技能很笨拙。

speaker: Unknown
en: You're fixing more than you're saving.
zh: 你在修补比你在节省的更多。

speaker: Unknown
en: Week four, the flywheel catches.
zh: 第四周，飞轮开始转动。

speaker: Unknown
en: The agent starts answering with your context.
zh: 智能体开始用你的上下文回答。

speaker: Unknown
en: The morning job produces something you actually read, and you write your third and fourth skill because the first two worked.
zh: 早上的任务产生了你真正会读的东西，并且你编写了你的第三个和第四个技能，因为前两个奏效了。

speaker: Unknown
en: Week 12, you have a library that answers before you finish asking.
zh: 第 12 周，你有一个在你还没问完之前就回答的库。

speaker: Unknown
en: A dozen skill files running the parts of your week you used to dread, and one or two tools that other people keep asking to borrow.
zh: 一打技能文件在运行你过去那一周中你害怕的部分，还有一两个其他人一直想借的工具。

speaker: Unknown
en: Which in this room is called a startup.
zh: 在这个房间里这被称为初创公司。

speaker: Unknown
en: The curve is the same curve as any compounding thing you've ever seen.
zh: 这条曲线和你见过的任何复利事物的曲线都是一样的。

speaker: Unknown
en: Flat, flat, flat, then not.
zh: 平，平，平，然后不平。

speaker: Unknown
en: Most people who try this will quit this in week two, which is precisely why the ones who don't feel like they're cheating by week 12.
zh: 大多数尝试这件事的人会在第二周放弃，这正是为什么那些没有放弃的人在第十二周时感觉像是在作弊。

speaker: Unknown
en: Now, I need to tell you the part that isn't fun, because everything I taught you just cuts both ways.
zh: 现在，我需要告诉你那个无趣的部分，因为我教给你的一切都是双向的。

speaker: Unknown
en: I told you Spinoza's definition of sadness earlier, the feeling of your power acting, power of acting, decreasing.
zh: 我之前告诉过你斯宾诺莎对悲伤的定义，那种行动力量的感觉，行动的力量，在减少。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I said it gets political.
zh: 我说过它会变得政治化。

speaker: Unknown
en: This is where.
zh: 就是这里。

speaker: Unknown
en: A skill file is not a document.
zh: 技能文件不是一个文档。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's a piece of your cognition, how you do the thing, extracted from your head, written down, and executable.
zh: 它是你认知的一部分，你如何做这件事，从你脑海中提取出来，写下来，并且可执行。

speaker: Unknown
en: Every skill you teach an agent is you, externalized.
zh: 你教给智能体的每一个技能都是外在化的你。

speaker: Unknown
en: And the exact same file is two opposite futures, depending on one variable who controls it.
zh: 完全相同的文件是两个相反的未来，取决于一个变量谁控制它。

speaker: Unknown
en: Take a fictional example of a support engineer.
zh: 以一个虚构的支持工程师为例。

speaker: Unknown
en: Let's call her Maya.
zh: 我们叫她 Maya。

speaker: Unknown
en: Over two years, Maya teaches her agents 40 skills.
zh: 两年内，Maya 教会了她的智能体 40 个技能。

speaker: Unknown
en: How to triage a P0 at 2 in the morning, how to deescalate the customer who's about to churn, how to write a postmortem that actually prevents the next incident.
zh: 如何在凌晨两点分流处理 P0 级事故，如何安抚那个即将流失的客户，如何撰写一个真正能防止下一次事故的事后复盘。

speaker: Unknown
en: 40 files.
zh: 40 个文件。

speaker: Unknown
en: That's her judgment, the thing that took her two years to build sitting on a disk.
zh: 那是她的判断力，那个花了她两年建立的、坐在磁盘上的东西。

speaker: Unknown
en: Version one, those files live in Maya's repo.
zh: 版本一，这些文件存在于 Maya 的代码库里。

speaker: Unknown
en: She changes jobs, they go with her.
zh: 她换工作时，它们跟她走。

speaker: Unknown
en: Day one at a new company, she's operating with years of compounded judgment on tap.
zh: 在新公司的第一天，她就在利用多年的积累判断力进行操作。

speaker: Unknown
en: Every year she works, she compounds.
zh: 她工作的每一年，她都在复利增长。

speaker: Unknown
en: That's ownership.
zh: 那就是所有权。

speaker: Unknown
en: And if she wanted to start a company that does this, it's her expertise, and it turns out she can.
zh: 如果她想创办一家做这个的公司，这是她的专业知识，结果是她可以。

speaker: Unknown
en: Entire startups these days will be Markdown files.
zh: 如今整个初创公司都会是 Markdown 文件。

speaker: Unknown
en: Version two.
zh: 版本二。

speaker: Unknown
en: Those files live in the company's repo under the company's IT policy.
zh: 那些文件存在于公司的代码库里，遵循公司的 IT 政策。

speaker: Unknown
en: Maya leaves with nothing.
zh: Maya 离开时什么也带不走。

speaker: Unknown
en: The company keeps running her judgment without her.
zh: 公司在没有她的情况下继续运行她的判断力。

speaker: Unknown
en: 40 files executing forever and her name isn't even in the commit history.
zh: 40 个文件永远执行，而她的名字甚至不在提交历史中。

speaker: Unknown
en: She didn't have a career, she had an extraction.
zh: 她没有过职业生涯，她经历了一场提取。

speaker: Unknown
en: Same files, same Maya, one variable.
zh: 相同的文件，相同的 Maya，一个变量。

speaker: Unknown
en: So this is the doctrine and I want you to be able to repeat it tomorrow.
zh: 所以这就是教条，我希望你们明天能复述它。

speaker: Unknown
en: I believe skill files are yours.
zh: 我相信技能文件是属于你的。

speaker: Unknown
en: Own your skills because...
zh: 拥有你的技能，因为……

speaker: Unknown
en: If you don't, your job becomes a skill file.
zh: 如果你不，你的工作就变成了一个技能文件。

speaker: Unknown
en: And this happened before.
zh: 这事以前发生过。

speaker: Unknown
en: Craftsmen owned their tools.
zh: 工匠拥有他们的工具。

speaker: Unknown
en: That's what made them free.
zh: 那正是让他们自由的原因。

speaker: Unknown
en: The factory broke that.
zh: 工厂打破了这一点。

speaker: Unknown
en: The loom belonged to the mill.
zh: 织布机属于磨坊。

speaker: Unknown
en: The knowledge workers assumed we were safe because our tools lived in our heads where nobody could confiscate them.
zh: 知识工作者曾以为我们是安全的，因为我们的工具存在于我们的脑子里，没人能没收它们。

speaker: Unknown
en: Skill files and that.
zh: 技能文件之类的东西。

speaker: Unknown
en: For the first time in history, your cognition can be extracted, stored, versioned, and owned.
zh: 历史上第一次，你的认知可以被提取、存储、版本化和拥有。

speaker: Unknown
en: The only question is, by whom?
zh: 唯一的问题是，由谁拥有？

speaker: Unknown
en: Do you remember the thousand guilders?
zh: 你还记得那一千荷兰盾吗？

speaker: Unknown
en: That offer never went away.
zh: 那个提议从未消失。

speaker: Unknown
en: It got rebranded.
zh: 它被改头换面了。

speaker: Unknown
en: Every comfortable arrangement where your judgment compounds in someone else's repo is a thousand guilders a year to show up, keep quiet, and stop building your own thing.
zh: 每一种让你的判断力在别人的仓库里复利的舒适安排，就是那一千荷兰盾一年，让你露面、闭嘴、并停止构建你自己的东西。

speaker: Unknown
en: And that's why you should start a startup, because this is how...
zh: 这就是为什么你应该创业，因为这就是……

speaker: Unknown
en: You can actually make those skill files work for you.
zh: 你实际上可以让这些技能文件为你工作。

speaker: Unknown
en: Spinoza faced the upgraded version 2 in 1673.
zh: 斯宾诺莎在 1673 年面对过升级版的版本 2。

speaker: Unknown
en: Heidelberg offered the cursed heretic a full professorship.
zh: 海德堡向这位遭诅咒的异端提供了一个全额教授职位。

speaker: Unknown
en: Salary, legitimacy, a chair, and, quote, freedom of philosophizing, provided he not disturb the established religion.
zh: 薪水、合法性、教席，以及，引用，「哲学思考的自由」，前提是他不扰乱既定宗教。

speaker: Unknown
en: His answer was, I do not know what the limits of that freedom of philosophizing might have to be.
zh: 他的回答是，我不知道那种哲学思考的自由可能必须有什么样的界限。

speaker: Unknown
en: He read the terms of service and he declined the acquisition.
zh: 他阅读了服务条款，然后他拒绝了这次收购。

speaker: Unknown
en: He had a phrase for what he was protecting, under your own power, as opposed to under someone else's.
zh: 他有一个短语来形容他正在保护的东西，在你自己的力量之下，相对于在别人的力量之下。

speaker: Unknown
en: Your power of acting exists either way.
zh: 你的行动力量无论如何都存在。

speaker: Unknown
en: The political question in 1673 and in 2026 is who commands it?
zh: 1673 年和 2026 年的政治问题是谁指挥它？

speaker: Unknown
en: Personal AI is about controlling your own cognitive abilities and protecting yourself.
zh: 个人 AI 是关于控制你自己的认知能力并保护你自己。

speaker: Unknown
en: That's the whole thesis of this talk in one sentence.
zh: 这就是这次演讲的整个主旨，用一句话概括。

speaker: Unknown
en: Personal AGI is how you stay under your own power in the age of agents.
zh: 个人 AGI 是你在智能体时代如何保持在你自己的力量之下。

speaker: Unknown
en: So keep your brain and your skills in a repo you control from day one before any platform or any acquirer has an opinion about it.
zh: 所以从第一天起就把你的大脑和你的技能保留在一个你控制的仓库里，在任何平台或任何收购者对它发表意见之前。

speaker: Unknown
en: When Spinoza died, they inventoried the room.
zh: 当斯宾诺莎去世时，他们清点了房间。

speaker: Unknown
en: Two pairs of pants, seven shirts, a lens lathe, 160 books.
zh: 两条裤子，七件衬衫，一台镜片车床，160 本书。

speaker: Unknown
en: And the ethics, locked in a desk.
zh: 还有《伦理学》，锁在书桌里。

speaker: Unknown
en: He owned almost nothing and nobody ever controlled his skill files.
zh: 他几乎什么都不拥有，也没人控制过他的技能文件。

speaker: Unknown
en: The desk drawer was his repo.
zh: 书桌抽屉是他的仓库。

speaker: Unknown
en: Own yours like he owned his.
zh: 像他拥有他的那样拥有你的。

speaker: Unknown
en: Now, three objections, and I can hear them from up here, so let's just do them.
zh: 现在，三个异议，我从这里都能听到，所以让我们直接处理它们。

speaker: Unknown
en: Objection one, the models are improving so fast that all this harness stuff will be obsolete.
zh: 异议一，模型改进太快了，所有这些工具带东西都会过时。

speaker: Unknown
en: Just wait for the next release.
zh: 只要等下一次发布。

speaker: Unknown
en: This is the bitter lesson crowd, and I love them, but notice what actually happens in every model release.
zh: 这是「苦涩教训」派，我喜爱他们，但请注意每次模型发布时实际发生了什么。

speaker: Unknown
en: The better the models get, the more the differentiator moves to context.
zh: 模型变得越好，差异化因素就越转移到上下文。

speaker: Unknown
en: When everyone's engine is 1,000 horsepower, the race is won on the driver and the map.
zh: 当每个人的引擎都是 1000 马力时，比赛的胜负取决于驾驶员和地图。

speaker: Unknown
en: The weights are everyone's.
zh: 权重是大家的。

speaker: Unknown
en: The library is yours.
zh: 库是你的。

speaker: Unknown
en: At least I hope it is.
zh: 至少我希望它是。

speaker: Unknown
en: A better model makes your library worth more because a smarter reader extracts more from the same books.
zh: 更好的模型使你的库更有价值，因为更聪明的读者能从同样的书中提取更多东西。

speaker: Unknown
en: I'm rooting for the labs as hard as anyone in this building, but every release they ship is a free upgrade to a workforce I already own and a workforce I want you to own.
zh: 我和这栋楼里的任何人一样努力地为实验室加油，但它们发布的每一个版本都是对我已经拥有的一次免费升级，也是我希望你拥有的一次免费升级。

speaker: Unknown
en: Objection two, is this just RAG?
zh: 异议二，这只是 RAG 吗？

speaker: Unknown
en: Sure, and Postgres is just B-trees.
zh: 当然，而且 Postgres 只是 B 树。

speaker: Unknown
en: Retrieval is the primitive, not the product.
zh: 检索是原语，不是产品。

speaker: Unknown
en: The hard part is everything around it, what gets written down in the first place, how it gets enriched and linked, what gets promoted to hot memory versus filed as cold reference, who arbitrates when two facts disagree.
zh: 困难的部分是它周围的一切，首先写下什么，它如何被丰富和链接，什么被提升到热内存而不是作为冷参考归档，当两个事实冲突时由谁仲裁。

speaker: Unknown
en: Retrieval is easy.
zh: 检索是容易的。

speaker: Unknown
en: Being worth retrieving from is the product.
zh: 值得从中检索才是产品。

speaker: Unknown
en: Objection three, and it's the one that deserves the most respect.
zh: 第三点反对意见，也是这一点最值得尊重。

speaker: Unknown
en: You put your entire life in one system, your email, your meetings, your kids' schedules, what happens when it leaks?
zh: 你把你的整个生活都放在一个系统里，你的电子邮件、你的会议、你孩子的日程表，如果它泄露了会发生什么？

speaker: Unknown
en: My answer is the same answer as the whole talk.
zh: 我的回答和整个演讲的回答是一样的。

speaker: Unknown
en: That's exactly why it has to be yours.
zh: 这正是为什么它必须属于你自己。

speaker: Unknown
en: My brain runs on my own infra, in my own repo, under my own keys.
zh: 我的 brain 运行在我自己的 infra 上，在我自己的 repo 里，在我自己的 keys 之下。

speaker: Unknown
en: Compare that to the default.
zh: 把这个和默认的情况做比较。

speaker: Unknown
en: Which is not privacy.
zh: 那并不是隐私。

speaker: Unknown
en: The default is your life is already scattered across 10 clouds owned by companies whose incentives are not yours, searchable by everyone except you.
zh: 默认的情况是你的生活已经散布在 10 个云端，这些云由那些利益与你不一致的公司拥有，除了你之外每个人都能搜索到。

speaker: Unknown
en: I didn't create the risk by consolidating my context.
zh: 我并没有通过整合我的上下文来制造这种风险。

speaker: Unknown
en: I took custody of it.
zh: 我接管了它。

speaker: Unknown
en: Custody is the security model.
zh: 接管才是安全模型。

speaker: Unknown
en: And if you don't trust yourself to hold the keys, I promise you the answer isn't trusting someone else's terms of service more.
zh: 如果你不相信你能持有密钥，我向你保证，答案不是去更相信别人的服务条款。

speaker: Unknown
en: So why did I open source all of it?
zh: 那么我为什么要开源所有这些东西呢？

speaker: Unknown
en: The harness, the brain architecture, the skills, the whole personal operating system.
zh: 这个 harness、这个 brain 架构、这些 skills、整个个人操作系统。

speaker: Unknown
en: People ask me this because they think there must be a catch.
zh: 人们问我这个问题，因为他们认为一定有什么猫腻。

speaker: Unknown
en: Well, the answer is because I can.
zh: 嗯，答案是因为我能。

speaker: Unknown
en: Because being at YC for me means I don't have to monetize my own infrastructure.
zh: 因为对我而言，身在 YC 意味着我不必将我自己的基础设施货币化。

speaker: Unknown
en: But because I can is also the answer to the wrong question.
zh: 但“因为我能”也是对错误问题的回答。

speaker: Unknown
en: The real question is why anyone should.
zh: 真正的问题是为什么任何人都应该这样做。

speaker: Unknown
en: And the answer is that I believe tools of the powerful should be given away.
zh: 答案是，我相信属于强者的工具应该被赠送出去。

speaker: Unknown
en: Every era has a private technology of leverage, a thing the powerful have and everyone else doesn't.
zh: 每个时代都有一种私有的杠杆技术，一种强者拥有而其他人没有的东西。

speaker: Unknown
en: For a long time, it was literacy.
zh: 在很长一段时间里，它是识字能力。

speaker: Unknown
en: Then it was capital.
zh: 然后它是资本。

speaker: Unknown
en: Right now, today, it's this, the harness, the library, the workforce made of Markdown.
zh: 就在现在，今天，就是这个，这个 harness、这个 library、这个由 Markdown 组成的劳动力。

speaker: Unknown
en: The people who have it are quietly operating at a different scale than the people who don't.
zh: 拥有它的人正在以一种与没有它的人不同的规模安静地运作。

speaker: Unknown
en: And the gap is widening every month.
zh: 这种差距每个月都在扩大。

speaker: Unknown
en: And that's what this whole conference is about, to give you the power to be able to do it for yourself.
zh: 这就是整个会议的意义所在，赋予你能够为自己做这件事的力量。

speaker: Unknown
en: When something like that, that powerful stays private, you get a priesthood.
zh: 当像这样强大的事物保持私有时，你得到的是一个教士阶层。

speaker: Unknown
en: When it gets given away, you get a renaissance.
zh: 当它被赠送出去时，你得到的是一场文艺复兴。

speaker: Unknown
en: I know which one I want to live in.
zh: 我知道我想生活在哪一个里。

speaker: Unknown
en: Which means I get to do the thing that I actually believe in.
zh: 这意味着我可以做我真正相信的事情。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I'll give it to you as a creed because it's the closest thing I have to one.
zh: 我会把它作为信条交给你，因为这是我最接近信条的东西。

speaker: Unknown
en: Say the things other people won't.
zh: 说出别人不会说的话。

speaker: Unknown
en: Fund the people other people won't.
zh: 资助别人不会资助的人。

speaker: Unknown
en: Build the buildings other people won't.
zh: 建造别人不会建造的建筑。

speaker: Unknown
en: Write and give away the code that other people won't.
zh: 编写并赠送别人不会赠送的代码。

speaker: Unknown
en: Leave behind the institutions that other people won't.
zh: 离开别人不会离开的机构。

speaker: Unknown
en: And when you build in the open, you should know what's coming because Spinoza's story has one more chapter.
zh: 当你在公开场合建造时，你应该知道即将到来的是什么，因为斯宾诺莎的故事还有一章。

speaker: Unknown
en: November 1676, Gottfried Leibniz, the most glittering genius in Europe, silk stockings, a calculating machine in his luggage, travels to The Hague to spend three days in an attic with the most hated man on the continent.
zh: 1676 年 11 月，Gottfried Leibniz，欧洲最璀璨的天才，丝袜，行李里装着一台计算机器，前往海牙在一个阁楼里与这片大陆上最被仇恨的人度过三天。

speaker: Unknown
en: And then he spends the next 40 years lying about it.
zh: 然后他在接下来的 40 年里都在为此撒谎。

speaker: Unknown
en: Publicly, the visit was a few hours in passing
zh: 在公开场合，这次拜访只是顺道的几个小时。

speaker: Unknown
en: Privately, his notes are crammed with obsessive commentary on Spinoza.
zh: 在私下里，他的笔记里塞满了他对斯宾诺莎的着迷评论。

speaker: Unknown
en: I live a small version of this weekly.
zh: 我每周都经历着这种生活的小型版本。

speaker: Unknown
en: I say agents write most of my code now, and the dunks arrive by lunch.
zh: 我说 agents 现在编写我大部分的代码，到了午饭时嘲讽就来了。

speaker: Unknown
en: Then I look at what the loudest dunkers are actually shipping, and it's agents all the way down.
zh: 然后我看那些声音最大的嘲讽者实际发布的是什么，那是一路到底的 agents。

speaker: Unknown
en: So learn the pattern now, because building in public guarantees you'll need it.
zh: 所以现在就要学会这个模式，因为在公开建造保证了你会需要它。

speaker: Unknown
en: First they quote tweet you, then they git clone you.
zh: 首先他们会引用推文你，然后他们会 git clone 你。

speaker: Unknown
en: The dunks are just the adoption curve announcing itself.
zh: 这些嘲讽只是采用曲线在自我宣告。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I want to show you what this architecture looks like when it's pointed at the only thing that really matters.
zh: 我想向你展示，当这个架构指向唯一真正重要的事情时，它是什么样子的。

speaker: Unknown
en: I have a friend whose son has a rare form of epilepsy.
zh: 我有一个朋友，他的儿子患有罕见形式的癫痫。

speaker: Unknown
en: No lab, no grant, no permission.
zh: 没有实验室，没有拨款，没有许可。

speaker: Unknown
en: He just went and you can just do things.
zh: 他直接去了，而你也可以直接做事。

speaker: Unknown
en: He built a repo of 80,000 Markdown files, a brain for one small boy, and pushed himself to the absolute edge of what humanity knows about his son's exact condition.
zh: 他建立了一个包含 80,000 个 Markdown 文件的代码库，一个为一个小男孩打造的大脑，并把自己推向了人类对其儿子确切病情认知的绝对边缘。

speaker: Unknown
en: Every specialist visit, every paper, every seizure log, every drug interaction, indexed and cross-linked and ready so that when a new doctor has an idea, he knows in minutes whether it's already been tried.
zh: 每一次专家问诊，每一篇论文，每一次癫痫发作记录，每一种药物相互作用，都被编入索引并交叉链接，准备就绪，以便当新医生有想法时，他能在几分钟内知道这是否已经尝试过。

speaker: Unknown
en: A father, a laptop, and a library.
zh: 一位父亲，一台笔记本电脑，和一个图书馆。

speaker: Unknown
en: That is personal AGI, not a benchmark, not a demo.
zh: 那就是个人 AGI，不是一个基准，不是演示。

speaker: Unknown
en: The entire architecture I've described tonight, the library, the librarian, the right three books open at the right moment,
zh: 今晚我描述的整个架构，图书馆，图书管理员，在正确时刻打开正确的三本书，

speaker: Unknown
en: Aimed at the one thing one man loves the most in the world.
zh: 指向这个人在世界上最爱的那件事。

speaker: Unknown
en: Nobody was coming to build that for him.
zh: 没有人会来为他构建那个。

speaker: Unknown
en: So he built it.
zh: 所以他自己构建了它。

speaker: Unknown
en: And nobody is coming to build yours for you.
zh: 也没有人会来为你构建你的。

speaker: Unknown
en: That's the good news.
zh: 这就是好消息。

speaker: Unknown
en: Everything you were told you needed, the team, the funding, the permission, the credential, was a workaround for the fact that one person could hold seven things in their head and work 16 hours a day.
zh: 你被告知需要的所有东西，团队，资金，许可，凭证，都是针对一个事实的变通方法，即一个人只能在脑海中记住七件事并且每天工作 16 小时。

speaker: Unknown
en: That fact just expired.
zh: 那个事实刚刚过期。

speaker: Unknown
en: You can fly now, not metaphorically, mechanically.
zh: 你现在可以飞了，不是隐喻上，是机械上。

speaker: Unknown
en: Every problem where you thought, I wish I had this person, I wish I could hire this person, but I can't get them.
zh: 对于每一个你以为“我希望我有这个人，我希望我能雇佣这个人，但我得不到他们”的问题。

speaker: Unknown
en: You can.
zh: 你可以。

speaker: Unknown
en: Every archive too big to read.
zh: 每一个太大而无法阅读的档案。

speaker: Unknown
en: Every data set too gnarly to clean.
zh: 每一个太棘手而无法清洗的数据集。

speaker: Unknown
en: Every ocean you were told not to boil.
zh: 每一个你被告知不要去煮沸的海洋。

speaker: Unknown
en: We can boil the ocean now.
zh: 我们现在可以煮沸海洋了。

speaker: Unknown
en: I have a sentence I live by, and I want to leave it with you.
zh: 我有一句我赖以生存的话，我想把它留给你们。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's all made up, but you get to make it up.
zh: 一切都是编造的，但你可以去编造它。

speaker: Unknown
en: Every institution in the world, including the one that read a curse over a 23 year old in 1656, was made up by people no smarter than you.
zh: 世界上所有的机构，包括那个在 1656 年给一位 23 岁的年轻人读诅咒的机构，都是由不比你聪明的人编造的。

speaker: Unknown
en: The difference between you and every generation of founders before you is that they had to recruit dozens of believers before they could build anything at all.
zh: 你和你之前的每一代创始人的区别在于，他们必须招募几十个信徒才能开始构建任何东西。

speaker: Unknown
en: You need a laptop and a few years of your own history you're already sitting on.
zh: 你需要一台笔记本电脑和你已经拥有的几年的自己历史。

speaker: Unknown
en: There are about
zh: 大约有

speaker: Unknown
en: 7,000 people at this whole event.
zh: 7,000 人参加了整个活动。

speaker: Unknown
en: 7,000 kenodises.
zh: 7,000 种 kenodises。

speaker: Unknown
en: 7,000 strivings.

speaker: Unknown
en: For most of history, almost all of that striving never got an audience.
zh: 在大部分历史中，几乎所有的这种奋斗都没有获得观众。

speaker: Unknown
en: It died waiting for funding, waiting for headcount, waiting for permission, waiting for someone else to believe first.
zh: 它在等待资金，等待人头编制，等待许可，等待别人先相信的过程中消亡了。

speaker: Unknown
en: The machinery I showed you tonight is the first technology I've ever seen that lets the striving go straight to work.
zh: 今晚我向你展示的机制是我见过的第一种让奋斗直接投入工作的技术。

speaker: Unknown
en: One person, no intermediaries, no permission.
zh: 一个人，没有中间人，没有许可。

speaker: Unknown
en: I genuinely do not think the world understands yet what 7,000 people with that kind of leverage walk out of a building and do.
zh: 我真的不认为世界已经理解了 7,000 个拥有这种杠杆的人走出大楼会做什么。

speaker: Unknown
en: Spinoza closed the ethics, the book that had to be smuggled out in a desk with nine words.
zh: 斯宾诺莎结束了《伦理学》，这本不得不藏在一个书桌里偷运出去的书只有九个词。

speaker: Unknown
en: All things excellent are as difficult as they are rare.
zh: 一切卓越的事物都像它们一样罕见一样困难。

speaker: Unknown
en: The difficulty just collapsed.
zh: 困难刚刚崩塌了。

speaker: Unknown
en: The rarity is now up to you.
zh: 稀缺性现在取决于你。

speaker: Unknown
en: Go and build.
zh: 去构建吧。

speaker: Unknown
en: Thank you.
zh: 谢谢。
